## Date & Application Filter

- **STRICT: Include jobs posted within the last 14 days ONLY** (use date filters: after:2026-06-01)
- Exclude archived, closed, or stale postings (6+ months old)
- Include openings with stated application deadlines not yet passed
- Flag "date unknown" if unable to determine posting date
- Prioritize roles matching Location "Ideal" or "Acceptable" tier

## Deal-breakers (Auto-filter)

Skip any job that mentions:
- "Pure admin", "data entry only", "non-creative"
- Requires relocation away from Dublin
- On-site only (remote/hybrid preferred, on-site in Dublin accepted)
- Large team / siloed department structure (if disclosed)
- Maintenance-only or legacy codebases (no new creative work)
- **Seniority:** Senior, Lead, Principal, Head of, Director, VP, C-level (exclude roles above mid-level)
- **Adult content industries:** Adult entertainment, escort services, NSFW platforms, adult websites, gaming/platforms with explicit content focus
